description: Maps legacy Section A A1 bar-chart program labels to Table A2 program row names (same reporting year). Used to PATCH cf_energysavingsmmbtu onto existing LEGACY_A1 facts and to align ingestion totals with Table A2.

knownLegacyInconsistencies.topic: Table A2 — 2023 MMBtu footer vs program lines
knownLegacyInconsistencies.summary: Packaged __LEGACY_DASH Table A2 shows a 2023 Total row (4,019,790 MMBtu) 337,064 above the sum of printed program lines (3,682,726). Reconcile Dataverse and verification to program-line sums, not the footer.

knownLegacyInconsistencies.topic: Table A3 — 2023 participant footer vs program lines
knownLegacyInconsistencies.summary: Packaged __LEGACY_DASH Table A3 shows a 2023 Total row (2,354,317 participants) 15,350 above the sum of printed program lines (2,338,967). Use row-detail sums as ground truth for ingestion and dashboard math, same pattern as A2 MMBtu.

aliases.pattern: A2 uses long-form '… - Electric & Gas'; A1 2023 chart uses short label.
A1 2023 chart carries '… - Electric & Gas'; A2 2023 row omits that suffix.

automationFindings.additionalSuffixOrStripMatches2023: none beyond the two aliases above
automationFindings.additionalSuffixOrStripMatches2024: none (all 12 A1 chart names match an A2 row verbatim)

chartWithoutTableRow.note: Present on A1_programs_2023 but no program line on Table A2 data_2023 in packaged legacy; not an alias—A2 gap unless the table is updated elsewhere.

relatedNamingNotAliases.note: These are year-over-year label changes on the bar chart. Within a single year, A2 strings follow the new naming (2024) or legacy naming (2023). Resolve dimensions per year in cf_DIMPROGRAM; do not use this file to equate 2023 chart names to 2024 table names.

Many Table A2 rows (e.g. AMEEP, EmPower, Marketplace, Smart Kids, Retail Lighting - LMI) are not A1 aliases—they simply do not appear on the 12-bar chart. Those require LEGACY_A2 facts (Step 3), not this map.
